verdict.rationale: Data export and portability is a fair question for a cloud sandbox platform, but the evidence pack documents no account-level export of all user data in open formats. The closest items are building blocks: filesystem access, reading files via exec, a logs fetch API, and proprietary snapshots. These are adjacent primitives, not an export-and-leave capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
